scope: Chronological evidence for every Explorer record, assembled from preserved IANA data, formal ICANN application archaeology and curated local evidence. External browser-time lifecycle enrichment is disabled in the pre-Reveal freeze.
ccTldMethod: IANA registration plus delegation/redelegation reports; gTLD Registry Agreement fields are not applied to ccTLDs.
evidenceRule: No missing date or historical phase is inferred. Only attributable, dated source evidence is rendered as a factual life-history event.
knownLimitation: Some early TLD operator changes predate central structured records and may remain undocumented in this dataset.
freezePolicy: The source remains documented for the controlled post-freeze update, but the publication does not request or merge it in the visitor browser before Reveal Day.
